payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: drawer catalog rewrites its cache file on every rescan — load_drawer_catalog (capture_drawers.rs) starts cache_dirty = true, so each 60 s TTL expiry re-serializes the whole cache even when no note changed (stale-TTL drawer menu ~32 ms vs ~15 ms warm on a 400-note fixture); initialize cache_dirty from whether any per-file entry was rescanned or dropped.

Drawer menu shipped in bob-cli: new capture_complete/drawers.rs builds task / recent / new groups; bob-authored detail ('2 notes', '1 note', 'empty', 'used in 12 notes · 3 days ago') and consequence ('Adds after "2 GB RAM" in REQUIREMENTS', 'Adds to X', 'Creates X under ^bar', '## ' forms on ^prj); refused comes from the same resolve_drawer_for_write/resolve_h2_for_write the commit uses (reserved copy now names the real key, was hardcoded LINKS); replacement is #slug only when the slug round-trips to the same drawer on the full target list, else #"TITLE"; Drawer field replacement now starts at the # and covers quoted literals (closed-literal query decodes without the closing quote); cursor_after; initial_selection none on empty query (drawer query now reported as 'query'); missing/duplicate/non-task target = diagnostic + no rows; ^prj keeps H2 task rows and also gets recent/new. Shell 'task sections' group -> 'drawers' in shell.rs, providers.rs, tests, docs/completion.md; sweep grep leaves only alias registration/test, justfile smoke, mkdocs redirect, decision-record text, grouped_task_sections family and one narrow --task-section negative test. Docs: capture.md, completion.md, json-outputs.md, capture-complete --help; just docs-gen + docs-check pass. Tests: new unit suite capture_complete/tests/drawers.rs, tests/cli/capture/complete_drawers.rs (incl. accept-row-then-dry-run round trip proving menu == commit), language field tests, capture_drawers helper tests; just check passes (fmt, clippy, 4265 lib + 2612 cli tests). Latency (release, 400 notes x 5 tasks x 3 drawers, XDG cache isolated): drawer menu warm 15.3 ms (empty) / 13.7 ms (typed) vs task_type 9.0 ms warm = +6 ms (target <=~20 ms); stale-60s-TTL rescan 31.7 ms; cold (no cache) 105 ms median on that heavier fixture (ey.2 recorded 19.6 cold / 23.7 warm on its fixture, so not directly comparable; old drawer menu never touched the catalog). Wire breaks (for feat(capture)! + BREAKING CHANGE footer): drawer row group 'drawers' -> 'task', replacement/replacement.start now cover the #, drawer row replacement carries leading '#'. Mac phase bob-cli-ey.7.4 should regenerate fixtures from this commit. No Cargo.toml/CHANGELOG edits.

payload.entry: LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: bob-cli-ey.7.2 note #1 proposes skipping drawer cache writes when no note changed. Declined as written: load_drawer_catalog persists last_scan_unix in the same JSON cache; after TTL expiry, omitting that write leaves every later process outside the 60-second TTL and forces repeated vault enumeration/aggregation. recent_count also ages with time even without note changes. The measured warm menu delta (+6 ms) meets the approved <=~20 ms target. A redesigned cache layout would be optional optimization, not unfinished drawer functionality; no task bead warranted for the proposed change. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries occur in the four repair phases.

LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (additional readiness findings): global sase plan links validate reports 58 unrelated historical errors, none naming this epic or its parent/descendant plans. Through sase_new_task: corroborated existing canceled stale-triage task bob-cli-y with a fresh post-close reproduction of its 57 prompt-in-plans-store errors (original proposer bob-cli-t.4.4); no duplicate created. The distinct 202610/bob_cli_7b_mac_compile.md PLAN-versus-PROMPT link-kind error was filed as small bug bob-cli-f4 and marked ready, proposed by this lander. Task/last-week sweeps across types and all 12 active epic scopes found no causal owner or duplicate for f4; bob-cli-1v and bob-cli-dg were reviewed and declined as duplicates because they cover wrong commit trailers and missing sidecars, respectively. Epic-linked plans resolve correctly; cli_directives_split and mac_directives are done. Keep these historical provenance issues out of drawer implementation.

LAND AUDIT: Read this epic and all four phase scopes/notes, normative repair and parent plans, parent decisions, and all parent descendant notes. Reviewed actual bob-cli commits f2b599c4/c7afa6d0 and current planner/parser/resolver/menu/tests, Mac b48d1b4/361e929 and real fixture generators/Swift decoding/preview, and plugin bff0345. Fresh scratch smokes at bob-cli 9625c9ac pass normal drawer/plain-child retyping, new-drawer exact bytes, JSON drawer object, named refusal codes and near-catalog warning, task/recent/new menus, D8 relocation with lane unchanged, refusal/later-item vault rollback, percent-n/listen/history/template directives, and bare-hash/percent unselected menus. Three epic-caused gaps remain: (1) valid ID-less --task-ref plus note #fix, with or without --drawer, exits 1 requiring a block ID (plan.rs sub_bullet_retype unwrap); (2) note @foo+bar # and note @foo+bar#requirements # report subject=new while typed #fix reports existing (incomplete mode drops task_types.rs sub_bullet_existing); (3) #req near REQUIREMENTS tells the user to quote REQUIREMENTS to create REQUIREMENTS, whereas parent section 3.2 requires the requested REQ override. The writer also lacks the approved focused exact-byte and transactional regression coverage. A medium tale will repair only these remaining paths and finish this epic and parent bob-cli-ey in the same implementation turn. Do not close yet. Mac CI 41308048455 snapshot d85e98c1 is tree-identical to landed 361e929 (git diff empty); build/lint passed and failure logs confirm exactly bob-cli-f3 seven baseline methods, no epic regressions. Mac retirement grep and bash syntax checks pass. Plugin promotion/reversal node suites: 68 passed. Follow-up dispositions are in preceding triage notes; no epic defects deferred to task beads.
